```python
def verify_d13f3404(I):
    x0 = asobject(I)
    x1 = mostcolor(I)
    x2 = matcher(first, x1)
    x3 = compose(flip, x2)
    x4 = sfilter(x0, x3)  # cells not of most common color
    x5 = apply(initset, x4)  # singleton objects for each non-background cell
    x6 = rbind(shoot, UNITY)  # shoot from center in direction (1,1)
    x7 = compose(x6, center)  # shoot from center
    x8 = fork(recolor, color, x7)  # recolor the shot line with original color
    x9 = mapply(x8, x5)  # union of all lines
    x10 = shape(I)
    x11 = double(x10)  # 6x6
    x12 = mostcolor(I)
    x13 = canvas(x12, x11)  # canvas filled with most common color
    x14 = paint(x13, x9)
    return x14
```

So for each non-background cell, draw a diagonal line down-right (direction (1,1)) starting from center (which is the cell itself), extending to boundary (42 steps), recolored with the cell's color. The background is the most common color.
